retention: Preserve immutable verified acquisitions for offline reuse and ordinary failure journals for inspection. No automatic deletion or production pointer replacement. Tiny diagnostic records remain transient; persist only delivery shapes, counts and hashes.
redistribution: PDDL permits reuse of covered rights. This implementation is source-separated internal processing; public record export is not implemented and must preserve applicable privacy and non-covered rights.
personal_data_handling: Center names and physical addresses may incidentally identify people. Exclude family-home categories, contacts and governing-body values; no personal enrichment.
authorization_basis: Existing user authorization to collect authorized US business data, verified official CDEC PDDL designation, exact center-only selection and bounded internal source-candidate processing. No account, credentials, payment or click-through agreement required.
semantic_boundary: provider_id is a source licensing identifier, not canonical business identity. Physical addresses are as reported in licensing applications, not independently verified premises. Preserve missing state/ZIP/capacity quality gaps and source clocks, keep normalized ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate, and leave coordinates and current operating status unverified. Programs may be public or private.
